parameters.inventory_rule: after demand t, order; receive before demand t+1

parameters.ambiguity: rectangular W-infinity balls around nonnegative relative residual samples

parameters.ro_calibration: training only; width grid 0:0.025:8 then local 0.001 refinement; original selection rules

ro_coverage.note: Diagnostic only; not used to select gamma; observed demands can fall outside the uncertainty set.
